note: Alberta Parks campground in Bow Valley Provincial Park, about 30 km east of Canmore, north of Hwy 1 off Hwy 1X; run by Cedar & Spruce Campgrounds. Open and treed sites; sites 70-109 are by reservation only, the power loop (sites 1-34) and the other unserviced sites are first-come. Taps run from May to closing, weather dependent; showers for a fee. --Claude
